title: Michael Eisner rejects the plasma fireworks
summary: Eric Hazeline tells of Michael Eisner rejects the plasma fireworks, about his Disney Imagineering years at Walt Disney Imagineering, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

plain: Eric Hazeline, who says he worked at Walt Disney Imagineering, the part of Disney that designs and builds its rides and park attractions, tells of showing his "plasma fireworks" to Michael Eisner, then Disney's chief executive. According to Hazeline, Eisner looked at them and said, "Oh, we're not going to do this." He tells it as a first-hand memory of his Disney years and of an idea that got turned down at the top.
